name: haxlab_site
description: Static academic lab website for HAX Lab.

scripts.copy:anime: node -e "import { mkdirSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('assets/vendor/animejs', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('node_modules/animejs/dist/bundles/anime.esm.js', 'assets/vendor/animejs/anime.esm.js');"
scripts.build: npm run copy:anime && npm run build:css
